recipe.text: I spoke with an ant the other day, but I didn't understand what he said. I guess I'm not so good at talking to animals.
recipe.label: Britanya tabanlı; düşünerek ve duraksayarak hedef

phonemes: aɪ spˈəʊk wɪð ɐn ˈant ðɪ ˈʌðə dˈeɪ, bˌʌt aɪ dˈɪdnt ˌʌndəstˈand wɒt hiː sˈɛd. aɪ ɡˈɛs aɪm nˌɒt sˌəʊ ɡˈʊd at tˈɔːkɪŋ tʊ ˈanɪməlz.
